mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, content, due_date, status, create_date, update_date, deleted_date FROM todo_lists WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_date IS NULL ORDER BY due_date ASC, create_date ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO todo_lists (user_id, content, due_date, status, create_date, update_date) VALUES (#{userId}, #{content}, #{dueDate}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
